body.name: Rank-\(r\) masked-cell benchmark statistic
body.construction: Choose the row-major lexicographically smallest fitted matrix \(\widehat L_M=AB^{\top}\) among minimizers of \(\sum_{(i,t)\in\Omega_0}(Y_{it}-A_i^{\top}B_t)^2\) under \(B^{\top}B/T=I_r\), \(\max_i\|A_i\|_2\le C_A\), and \(\max_t\|B_t\|_2\le C_B\). Then set \(\widehat{\operatorname{ATT}}_M=(n_1t_1)^{-1}\sum_{i:d_i=1}\sum_{t:qvec_t=1}(Y_{it}-\widehat L_{M,it})\).
